'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] raid the village of [[Qabatiya]] in the [[West Bank]], killing two [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] men. In a separate incident, Israeli forces arrest an 18-year-old Palestinian man and kill his father in the [[Qalandia]] refugee camp. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/palestinians-say-israeli-army-kills-man-in-west-bank-raid/2023/01/12/2198b246-9244-11ed-90f8-53661ac5d9b9_story.html (AP via ''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/rj00css6qo (Ynetnews)]
*[[2022–2023 Peruvian political protests]]
**The city of [[Cusco]] is placed under red alert after one person is killed and 17 others are injured in clashes between protesters and [[National Police of Peru|police]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/12/americas/peru-anti-government-protests-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**The [[National Institute of Statistics and Census of Argentina]] records a 94.8% [[inflation]] rate for [[Economy of Argentina|its economy]] in 2022, the highest since 1991. [https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/economy/argentina-ended-2022-with-948-inflation-highest-rate-in-32-years.phtml (AFP via ''Buenos Aires Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornado outbreak of January 12, 2023]]
**A [[tornado outbreak]] in the [[US state]]s of [[Alabama]] and [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] damages several towns and kills at least six people. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/weather/2023/01/12/southern-storms-deaths-alabama-tornado-damage/11041594002/ (''USA Today'')]
*A truck crashes into several [[Share taxi|minibus taxis]] at an [[intersection (road)|intersection]] in [[Roodepoort]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]], killing five people and injuring nine others. [https://www.news24.com/news24/southafrica/news/absolute-mayhem-5-killed-several-injured-after-truck-crashes-into-taxis-in-roodepoort-20230112 (News24)]
*An [[explosion]] at a [[propane]] store in [[Saint-Roch-de-l'Achigan, Quebec|Saint-Roch-de-l’Achigan]], [[Quebec]], [[Canada]] leaves three people missing. [https://montreal.ctvnews.ca/service-planned-after-explosion-that-left-3-missing-in-st-roch-de-l-achigan-que-1.6230959 (CFCF-DT)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Mining in Sweden|Swedish mining]] company [[LKAB]] discovers Europe's largest known [[Mineral deposit|deposit]] of [[rare-earth element]]s in [[Kiruna]], [[Sweden]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/swedens-lkab-finds-europes-biggest-deposit-rare-earth-metals-2023-01-12/ (Reuters)]
*The [[World Meteorological Organization]] of the [[United Nations]] reports an average [[Global surface temperature|global temperature]] of about 1.15{{nbsp}}°C above pre-industrial levels in 2022, confirming that the last eight years were the [[Highest temperature recorded on Earth|highest temperatures recorded on Earth]] since [[Instrumental temperature record|records]] began. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/climate-and-environment/2023/01/13/2237352/un-confirms-2022-among-eight-hottest-years-record (AFP via ''The Philippine Star'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Beninese parliamentary election]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Benin|Constitutional Court]] declares that the parties supporting [[President of Benin|President]] [[Patrice Talon]], including the [[Progressive Union for Renewal]] and the [[Republican Bloc]], have won a majority of 81 out of 109 seats in the [[National Assembly (Benin)|National Assembly]]. The parties have been accused of [[electoral fraud]] by the opposition [[The Democrats (Benin)|Democrats]] party, who plan to contest the results. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230112-benin-pro-govt-parties-win-parliament-majority (AFP via RFI)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban#International response|International response to the treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**[[Cricket Australia]] announces the withdrawal of the [[Australia national cricket team|Australia national team]] from their [[One Day International]] matches against [[Afghanistan national cricket team|Afghanistan]] scheduled for March in response to the [[Taliban government]]'s recent prohibitions of education and employment for women. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/12/sport/australia-afghanistan-cricket-taliban-intl-hnk-spt/index.html (CNN)]
